home.hero_description: Celebrating excellence in Quran memorization. Join us for an inspiring journey of knowledge, devotion and achievement.
home.about_body: The Musabaqa is Jamia Mosque Nairobi's annual Quran memorization competition, bringing together students from madrasas, schools, and mosques across Nairobi and beyond.
home.prizes_body: Top performers in each category receive certificates of excellence, trophies, and special recognition from the Jamia Mosque Committee.
